purpose: Publish enhanced native Central Texas Roemer's spurge field card with verified seed-pit and caruncle microscopics, preserving prior five-photo habitat and anatomy lessons.
source_rights_and_botany: Nathan Taylor's 2019 iNaturalist Euphorbia advanced seed morphology lesson directly identifies two seed closeups and source observation 22577311. Exact species plus individual CC BY-NC license verified with real photo files, cropped/EXIF-safe. Two true detached seeds show deep irregular pits and pale caruncles. No absolute millimeter calibration inferred. Four checked arrows added to two seed views. Other source/photo rights unchanged.
